items.title: Re-vendor LibKa0s v1.71.0 from the local tag; record the unrecorded v1.69.0/v1.70.0 span; de-tag live docs
items.spec: Mechanical re-vendor per the revendor convention (no adoption interview, no GitHub issue filing). (1) Copy LibKa0s at the LOCAL tag v1.71.0 whole: ../LibKa0s LibKa0s/ -> libs/LibKa0s/ and testkit/ -> tests/_kit/ (rm then copy, so deleted files go too). Kit revision 37 -> 38 (LK-01: --list Totals count only cases that run, a '| Skipped | N |' row for declared skips). (2) CLAUDE.md provenance line 'Bundles [LibKa0s](...) v1.70.0 (MIT).' -> v1.71.0, same commit. (3) Span bundle for the two unrecorded re-vendors (547ac68 v1.69.0, 735a111 v1.70.0): docs/revendor/<date>-v1.69.0-v1.70.0/ with 01_DELTA.md whose line 1 is exactly 'Delta: LibKa0s v1.69.0 -> v1.70.0 (span: v1.69.0 v1.70.0)' and whose body names base v1.68.1 (the provenance at the time) and the per-file minor moves (WidgetsLineChart / WidgetsAutocomplete arrived), and 05_SUMMARY.md with one line per tag: carried by a plain chore re-vendor commit (sha), nothing adopted. (4) docs/revendor/<date>-v1.71.0/ bundle: delta base v1.70.0 (from the CLAUDE.md provenance line, not the library's previous tag), per-file LibStub minors, kit 37 -> 38 pairing, which majors PFE consumes, contract changes (Slash ParseValue refuses nan/inf, Env/OptionsIdList dead rungs dropped, LineChart/Autocomplete minors), and a 'Not adopted in this run' list (Kit.secret simulator, WidgetsLineChart, WidgetsAutocomplete and any other new surface) per OWNER_SCOPE. (5) Regenerate docs/test-cases.md with `lua tests/run.lua --list` (kit 38 semantics: declared skip moves to the Skipped row) and set the README Tests badge to the new Total (passing/Total, equal to the Totals row). (6) De-tag live docs that restate the vendored version (PFE-A-11): docs/ARCHITECTURE.md:23 and :43, DEPENDENCIES.md:32 ('kit 36'), docs/debug.md:16 ('from LibKa0s v1.68.1') point at the CLAUDE.md provenance line instead of naming a tag/kit; docs/smoke-tests.md:55 update only the INSTALL-4 step text, never its Result and never the :645 owner results row. (7) PFE-A-05: cut the docs/ARCHITECTURE.md Overview re-vendor narrative (line 55, v1.64.0..v1.68.1, ~1600 chars) to one sentence pointing at docs/revendor/; do not move '## The disabled state is total'. Hub ends below its 435 lines.
items.steps: 1. Confirm `git -C ../LibKa0s tag -l v1.71.0` exists locally (LK-12 done). 2. rm -rf libs/LibKa0s tests/_kit; copy both payloads from `git -C ../LibKa0s archive v1.71.0` (or a checkout of the tag in a temp worktree, removed afterwards). 3. Roll the CLAUDE.md provenance line. 4. Run the green gate; test_vendor_sync must pass; fix nothing in the payload. 5. Regenerate docs/test-cases.md, update the README badge. 6. Write both docs/revendor bundles (span bundle first). 7. De-tag the four live docs and the INSTALL-4 step text; cut the Overview narrative. 8. Gate again; commit 'RV-PF: re-vendor LibKa0s v1.71.0; record v1.69.0-v1.70.0 span (PFE-A-02, PFE-A-11, PFE-A-05)'.

items.title: Secure-write queue: one raising deferred write no longer orphans the rest; unwrapFrame re-wrap guarded
items.spec: core/PartyFrameEnhanced.lua flushSecure (:92-106): snapshot both `pending` and `pendingOrder` and replace them with fresh empty tables BEFORE running anything; then for each key in the snapshot order run its closure through xpcall(fn, geterrorhandler()) so an error still reaches BugSack/the default handler and the loop continues; count successes and failures and debug-log 'flushed %d deferred write(s), %d raised'. Consequences that must hold: after a raise the queue is empty (PendingSecureCount()==0, PendingSecureKeys() empty), a later in-combat RunSecure on the raising key re-queues it (the `if not pending[key]` guard sees nil), and OnLeaveCombat (:264-267) and the stand-down path still reach NS.PublishVisibility() after the flush. PFE-R-03: modules/SecureFollow.lua unwrapFrame (:193-201): the restoring SecureHandlerWrapScript(frame, SCRIPT, h, pre, post) runs through xpcall(..., geterrorhandler()) (never a bare pcall that discards the error) so the unwrap pass continues, consistent with Wrap's own guard (~:173); return false either way. PFE-R-05: settings/Slash.lua PROFILE_VERBS.new (:309-317): remove NS.ResetProfileCounted(db) after db:SetProfile(name) (the exists() refusal already guarantees a default-only profile) and rewrite the comment above it, which says 'SetProfile first, then the reset'; keep the exists() refusal and the 'Created and switched' line. Update docs/ARCHITECTURE.md (secure queue notes) and docs/slash-dispatch.md/docs/profiles.md wherever they describe the reset step.

'-- red under:' notes naming the unguarded loop. 2. items.title: Profile change in combat cannot turn preview on: PROFILE receiver honours the combat refusal
items.spec: modules/Preview.lua PROFILE receiver (:198-204): when NS.GetSetting('enabled')==true and the incoming profile stores locked==false and InCombatLockdown() is true, write NS.SetByPath('locked', true) (so the stored profile is relocked, matching the PLAYER_REGEN_DISABLED re-lock) and print the existing combat re-lock line (reuse the same L[] string AcceptLock/combat re-lock already prints, no new locale key unless none exists); do NOT call applyLock(true). Otherwise behaviour is unchanged (disabled -> applyLock(false); else applyLock(locked==false)). This closes the '/pfe profile copy <name>' route (settings/Slash.lua copy verb has no combat check: CopyProfile -> OnProfileCopied -> adoptProfile -> PROFILE) and any third-party SetProfile. Update the receiver's comment and docs/ARCHITECTURE.md / docs/profiles.md where the combat guard is described.

items.title: Pending-secure listener moves from a private CreateFrame to a dedicated AceEvent target (events-frames-taint-§1)
items.spec: core/PartyFrameEnhanced.lua :107-138: replace `regenWatch = CreateFrame('Frame')` with a dedicated AceEvent target that is not the addon object and not NS.bus (e.g. `local regenWatch = {}; LibStub('AceEvent-3.0'):Embed(regenWatch)`, the pattern core/Bus.lua:56 uses), created once. armPendingRegen: return if #pendingOrder==0; if not armed, NS.SafeRegisterEvent(regenWatch, 'PLAYER_REGEN_ENABLED', handler, NS.RejectedEvents) (check SafeRegisterEvent's AceEvent-target signature in core and use it as Bus does) and set a local `regenArmed=true` only on success. Handler: unregister PLAYER_REGEN_ENABLED, regenArmed=false, then flushSecure(). disarmPendingRegen: if armed, regenWatch:UnregisterEvent('PLAYER_REGEN_ENABLED'), regenArmed=false. NS.PendingRegenArmed() returns regenArmed (truthful; diagnostics unchanged). The (event,target) collision with addon:OnLeaveCombat is avoided because the target differs. Rewrite the block comment (:107-116) to say 'its own AceEvent target' and why; update docs/ARCHITECTURE.md:199 ('its own frame' -> 'its own AceEvent target') and :269. Still the only registration a stood-down addon keeps (slash-commands-§7), released on fire.
